visa-preparation.entry_summary: Visa-free (entry via Italy - Schengen rules apply).
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: No visa: San Marino is reached through Italy (open border), so the Schengen 90 days in 180 rule applies in practice.
steps: San Marino isn't a Schengen member but is only reached through Italy.
At the first Schengen border, give fingerprints and a photo for the Entry/Exit System (EES); it's free.
Stays over 90 days need a national visa or a bilateral waiver arranged before travel.
